titles.title: Abstraction White

description: Vertical canvas of mostly white, grey, and black.  A diagonal line from the upper right to the lower left divides the canvas, and a second diagonal line starts in the middle of the first and goes from left to lower right ending in the middle of the bottom of the canvas.  A dark black area follows the lines of the diagonals on the right, blending out into grey and back to white.
